items.title: Trail Blazers Sign Caleb Houstan To Exhibit 10 Deal
items.author: Hoops Rumors
items.body_excerpt: Trail Blazers Sign Caleb Houstan To Exhibit 10 Deal Hoops Rumors

items.title: The Blazers are signing Caleb Houstan to an Exhibtion 10 contract, according to a league source. Houstan, who has played in 186 games for the Magic and Hawks, is expected to join the Rip City Remix.
